entries.heading: D — Discriminative yield

entries.heading: C — Difficulty coverage
entries.text: Normalized entropy of solve-rate bucket occupancy, over equal-width bins on [0, 1] . Tasks spread evenly give C = 1 ; tasks all clustered in one bucket give C = 0 .
